steps.text: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position. You can close your eyes or lower your gaze to the floor.
Take a few deep breaths. Breathe in slowly through your nose and out even more slowly through your mouth.
Bring your attention to your feet. Feel your toes, soles and heels. If there's tension, let it go as you breathe out.
Move on to your calves and knees. Just notice them, without trying to change anything.
Feel your thighs and hips. Let your weight sink into the surface you're sitting or lying on.
Focus on your pelvic area and pelvic floor. If there's any unintentional tightness here, let it soften as you breathe out.
Watch your belly rise and fall with your breath. Relax your abdominal muscles.
Move on to your back and shoulders. Move your shoulders away from your ears and let them drop.
Feel your arms, hands and fingers. Let your hands feel heavy and warm.
Relax your neck, jaw, forehead and the area around your eyes. If you're clenching your teeth, let go.
Now feel your whole body as one. Take one more deep breath and let it out slowly. Open your eyes when you're ready.
